    Chosen split-basic presentations #

    A split-basic finite-dimensional algebra has semisimple quotient a finite product of copies of its coefficient field. This file packages a compatible complete family of primitive idempotent lifts and defines the ordinary Cartan matrix in that ordering.

    source
    structure LargeIndecomposable.SplitBasicIdempotents {k : Type u} [Field k] {A : Type v} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] {ι : Type x} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :
    Type (max (max u v) x)

    Chosen split-basic idempotents: a complete orthogonal family whose images identify the semisimple quotient with the coordinate idempotents of k^ι. This is the presentation on which the ordinary Cartan matrix is computed.

    • idempotent : ι → A

      Chosen primitive idempotent lifts.

    • complete : CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents self.idempotent
    • quotientEquiv : (A ⧸ Ring.jacobson A) ≃ₐ[k] ι → k
    • quotientEquiv_mk_idempotent (i j : ι) : self.quotientEquiv ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ring.jacobson A)) (self.idempotent i)) j = if i = j then 1 else 0
